title: Multiplied Blessings: Eighteen Short Readings
author: Edward Hoare

authorInfo.bio: Edward Hoare (1812–1894) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Multiplied Blessings: Eighteen Short Readings" by Edward Hoare is a collection of reflections and sermons likely written in the late 19th century. The work distills the essence of Christian faith, emphasizing themes of divine forgiveness, guidance, and the transformational power of grace.
